body: GOLDEN PORTABILITY FINDING: Scala.js cannot link Class.getResourceAsStream, and the real WOG inference is numerically stable but not bit-identical across libm targets: JVM+JS canonical bytes hash cdc8047d...44b3; Native hashes c347bf9f...ccd03. Native contextual decode/re-encode still passed. I split the proof honestly: common JVM/JS/Native suite runs real WOG inference, checks canonical/no-text bytes and exact contextual roundtrip; JVM-only resource suite asserts committed 25,598-byte hsmm-v1 JSON == generated bytes, checksum cdc8047d...44b3, and committed decode == original. This meets committed-golden and 3-platform codec evidence without claiming cross-platform floating-bit identity. Cross-platform decoding of the JVM resource itself would require a build-time resource-to-Scala generator beyond the approved one-line build scope; I do not recommend that duplication unless required.
